name: Rockchip Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Rockchip Electronics Co., Ltd. operates as a fabless IC design company focusing on Intelligent IoT in China. The company offers artificial intelligent application processor chips, including general application processors, machine vision processors, audio processors, etc.; and power management, interface conversion, wireless connection, fast charging protocol, and other digital-analog hybrid chips, as well as modules and other products. It also provides system-on-chip (SoC) for tablet, notebook, Chromebook, IPTV/OTT-Box, Internet of Things (IoT), smart audio products, intelligent video application in smartphone, drone, IPC, CVR, robotics, and other smart devices.
